title: Novel Gene Signatures Predicting Primary Non-response to Infliximab in Ulcerative Colitis: Development and Validation Combining Random Forest With Artificial Neural Network.
summary: RF/ANN gene signature for primary infliximab nonresponse in UC; GSE16879 and GSE12251 training (n=46 total), independent GSE23597 validation (n=28), response assessed at 4/8 weeks using mucosal healing definition.
ai_technology: Learned gene signature predicts a specific treatment-response endpoint in independent public data; retrospective and small-cohort.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: RF/ANN gene signature for primary infliximab nonresponse in UC; GSE16879 and GSE12251 training (n=46 total), independent GSE23597 validation (n=28), response assessed at 4/8 weeks using mucosal healing definition.
evidence.unknown: The gene signature was trained on 46 cases and checked in 28 independent cases; these small transcriptomic cohorts do not establish causal mechanisms or clinical utility.
